summary: Attach multiple free-form tags to an alert (new Tag entity + AlertTags many-to-many), add/remove tag endpoints, composable tag filter on GET /api/alerts, and tags in AlertResponse.
constraints: Slice is intentionally broader than the 5-file soft cap: the many-to-many tagging feature spans Models, Data, Data.SQL, DTO, Common, and API layers end-to-end.
Tag is a first-class entity (Id, Name) with a unique index on normalized Name; many-to-many via EF-managed join table AlertTags.
Case-insensitive normalization/dedup; trim input; reject empties; store a single canonical representation.
Max 10 tags per alert enforced in the service after dedup against existing assignments; each tag 1-30 chars after trim.
DELETE returns 404 for both alert-missing and assignment-missing cases.
GetByIdAsync/GetAllAsync must Include Tags so AlertResponse.Tags is populated (reconcile AsNoTracking + Include).

Repository is the only EF boundary; service must not reference EF Core. Follow existing conventions: AlertConstants, DataAnnotations + IValidatableObject, manual mapping extensions, enum-as-string, UTC datetime2.
Migrations are authoritative; also update idempotent SQL mirror database/02_AlertServiceDb_Migrations.sql.
Security: validate tag input at trust boundary; parameterized EF LINQ (no injection); no secrets; errors must not leak internals.
unresolved_questions: Canonical tag casing (lowercase vs first-seen) to confirm during implement-story; default to case-insensitive normalization.
